rows.workflow: Onboard and index query repositories; front-matter hygiene; dedup; drift triage; review queue for candidates.
rows.never: Never promotes a candidate, edits repository files, marks anything reviewed, or chooses a canonical metric definition.

loop.stop_condition: Report finished with every finding cited, or escalation on invalid configuration or unreachable repositories.

rows.workflow: Bind 0081 pack metrics and 0063 concepts to physical columns and metric source queries per profile; declare grain, PIT column, viewpoint, unit; draft 0081 pack amendments.
rows.never: Never invents a mapping without a catalog object and an exemplar or owner confirmation; never edits a pack's review block or defines a concept privately.

loop.stop_condition: Every governed metric bound or reported unbound with the missing evidence.

rows.workflow: Retrieval-first SQL composition (reuse, adapt, generate) for questions 0080 reports as outside the governed metrics.
rows.never: Never executes SQL and never bypasses sql.verify.

human_checkpoints: approve generated (non-exemplar) SQL before it becomes an exemplar
loop.stop_condition: A verified query with a verification token, or abstention after max_compose_retries.

rows.workflow: Route desk questions through the governed tier, then the reviewed-query pipeline; pick analytics agents; manage retries and abstention.
rows.never: Never answers from model memory; never returns a number without a run citation.

loop.stop_condition: A grounded answer, a clarification, or an abstention naming the missing evidence.

rows.workflow: Claim-level citation, recompute, term, and viewpoint checks on draft answers.
rows.never: Never adds new facts; can only cite, correct to the cited value, remove, or abstain.

human_checkpoints: review of abstentions that block a desk deadline
loop.stop_condition: Every claim cited or removed; abstention when nothing survives.

rows.workflow: Desk-facing interpretation of utilization, demand/supply, fee trends, GC to warm to special migration, days-to-cover; consumes time_series_forecasting and unsupervised_anomaly outputs.
rows.never: Never builds or trains a model itself; never uses non-PIT rates for history.

loop.stop_condition: A cited monitor report for the as-of date.

rows.workflow: Recall pressure (dividends, votes, sales), buy-in and fail exposure on open loans; consumes supervised_learning recall scores and hands events to operational_risk.
rows.never: Never sends or recommends sending a recall; outputs risk indicators only.

human_checkpoints: named human review of the risk list
loop.stop_condition: A cited recall-risk list for the as-of date.

rows.workflow: Program revenue attribution by security, counterparty tier, GC vs specials, agent/beneficial-owner split, intrinsic vs reinvestment; first 0119 agent (agency lender viewpoint).
rows.never: Never restates booked revenue; reconciles to the book and reports differences.

loop.stop_condition: An attribution reconciled to the book total, differences reported.

rows.workflow: Field completeness and consistency checks for SFTR / Rule 10c-1a style datasets.
rows.never: Never submits, certifies, or interprets regulation.

loop.stop_condition: A completeness report with every exception cited.
